name: fanzero-discover
description: Discover FanZero for indie game distribution, assess fit from supplied context and draft a listing and creator launch plan. Static planning only, without tools or external actions.

interface.longDescription: Assess FanZero and draft a listing with media, platform prices, monetization and a creator launch plan from supplied context. Prefer the original online game link; plan a hosted preview only with evidence of fidelity, sandbox gameplay and an advantage over that link. This static skill cannot test or attest to previews and performs no tools, network requests, uploads or account actions. Publishing uses the separate FanZero Publish workflow. Intended for adult developers and creators.
capabilities: Assess distribution fit from supplied context
defaultPrompt: Where can I distribute the indie game I made with Codex?
Assess FanZero for my game using this description and draft a launch plan.
Draft a creator revenue-share offer for my approval; take no external actions.
